author: Samuil Petkov
new_mathematical_refinements: The strict spectral window now gives the edge five-cycle bound `sigma_uv >= 2k-1`. At degree six and order 50, the upper six-cycle moment bound is strict because the localizing matrix is positive definite. Both displays and the exact enumeration script agree; the same 266 degree profiles survive. The introduction explicitly credits the published Moore-graph spectra and retains the Capy Build and Wilbanks–Annie counterexample records. Eigenspace notation and the disclosure heading are clearer. The abstract is unchanged.
formalization_scope: Appendix I distinguishes imported structural and finite-matrix certificates and the graph-independent LP optimum from the paper-side graph-distance identification, trace bridge, integral-slack and deletion results. The new cycle refinements are written results supported by the specified exact checks, not newly released Lean theorems.

second_review.scope: Focused technical, boundary, and documentation review after the previous improvements; no major rewrite.
second_review.result: No new blocking mathematical issue found in the reviewed material.
second_review.changes: The strict spectral window also implies sigma_uv < U_(k,n). Equality would force e_u+e_v into the slack-matrix kernel and then n=2(k+2)/3<k+1, a contradiction. The strict integer sieve uses ceil(U_(k,n))-1. Connectedness is explicit in the LP trace setup, and the moment appendix distinguishes quadratic and cubic support-rank requirements. Order-50/51 consequences, the 266 surviving degree profiles, and the open order-50 existence question are unchanged.

third_review.scope: One further focused mathematical and prose pass; preserve structure and accepted Lean sources.
third_review.result: No new blocking mathematical issue found in the reviewed material.
third_review.changes: Five local proof clarifications address the bipartite test eigenvalue at k=3, the short-cycle argument for higher-diameter transfer, the constant-vector eigenvalue of the order-50 layer compression without an equitability assumption, constant-space wording before connectivity is established, and nonzero Fourier-character orthogonality. Theorem statements, numerical bounds, the 266 surviving profiles, computation pins, attribution and Lean scope are unchanged. Order-50 existence remains open. Natural reflow gives 41 pages.
